item.title: Confessional 1.15.0
item.description:
• Dictate into any app: hold ⌃⌥D, talk, let go, and the text is typed where your cursor is (Settings → Dictation), with an optional AI tidy-up
  • Watch folders: new recordings in a folder you choose (Zoom's, your podcast's raw folder) are transcribed, summarised and filed automatically (Settings → Watch Folders)
  • Import several recordings at once, or drop them on the Meetings window

item.title: Confessional 1.14.0
item.description:
• One place for where AI runs: Settings → AI Models now starts with Cloud, On this Mac, or Choose per feature, plus a list of every AI feature and the model it uses
  • A ☁︎/🔒 label wherever AI runs (chat, Studio, projects, Analytics, Ask, digest, summaries): click to move that feature to the cloud or this Mac, or turn it off
  • No silent switching: if your chosen model isn't available the label turns orange and says what's used instead; a feature set to this Mac never falls back to the cloud

item.title: Confessional 1.13.0
item.description:
• Edit an episode by editing its transcript: cut lines, remove ums, uhs and repeated words, shorten long pauses (Studio → Edit)
  • Podcast-ready sound: exports levelled to -16 LUFS with voices evened out and peaks under -1 dB
  • Separate tracks: keep your mic and the call (Settings → Recording) and export them as WAV files with the same cuts
  • Project Insights: topics over time, action items opened vs. closed, who comes and who talks, what's waiting longest

item.title: Confessional 1.12.0
item.description:
• Studio for podcasters and creators: an episode kit (titles, description, show notes, YouTube chapters, quotes, social posts, keywords), captions (.srt/.vtt) and craft stats
  • Clips: AI finds the most shareable moments; export vertical, square or landscape videos with word-by-word captions, or audio
  • Prep an episode from your notes and past episodes; import audio or video into a show

item.title: Confessional 1.11.0
item.description:
• AI built in: download the best Gemma 4 model for your Mac (Settings → AI Models) and run every AI feature privately, with nothing to set up
  • Record for a project: a Record button on each project page files the meeting there from the start

item.title: Confessional 1.10.0
item.description:
• Chat history: every conversation kept, with search, pinning and renaming (⌘N for a new one)
  • Edit a question to ask again, regenerate answers, suggested follow-up questions
  • Attach files and screenshots to a message; dictate with the microphone
  • Turn an answer into an email, a Word document or reminders
  • Memory: facts every chat knows (“Remember that…”)

item.title: Confessional 1.9.0
item.description:
• Projects read your documents: add files or folders (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text…) or drop them on the new Sources tab
  • Projects read your email: matching messages from Apple Mail, by people or subject
  • Projects read the code folder: source files, READMEs and git history
  • Any source can be kept on this Mac, like meetings

item.title: Confessional 1.8.0
item.description:
• Everything in one window: Home, Chat, Projects, Analytics and Highlights in the sidebar; opens on Home and stays there
  • Analytics: topics over time worked out on your Mac, what each meeting was about, rising and fading topics, who you meet with
  • Unexpected connections between meetings about different things, with AI explanations
  • Projects redesigned as cards and a project page with tiles

item.title: Confessional 1.7.0
item.description:
• A new home page: what's next with Record & Join, your week at a glance, recent meetings and projects as tiles
  • Clear indicators for computer call vs phone/in person, and cloud AI vs on this Mac (click to switch)
  • Chat looks at the screenshots itself when you ask about something that was on screen

item.title: Confessional 1.6.0
item.description:
• Projects: meetings grouped automatically, each with a living overview (where things stand, what changed, decisions over time, recurring themes, open items) and its own chat
  • Deeper answers: for big-picture questions, chat reads each relevant meeting in full and links to exact moments
  • Send to Claude Code: hand action items to Claude Code in your project's code folder, with quotes and screenshots
  • Screenshots the AI understands: key screenshots are described (what was shown, highlighted or broken) and used in summaries, chat and Claude Code briefs
